reports.title: The Aaon Group Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Results, Restates First and Second Quarter 2026 Financial Statements and Raises Full-Year Outlook

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: Based on strong third quarter performance, increased manufacturing throughput, and current business conditions, the Company raised its full-year 2026 outlook:

Current | Prior
Metric | FY26 | FY26
YoY Sales Growth | 72%-75% | 55%-60%
Gross Profit Margin | ~26% | 25%-26%
SG&A as a % of sales | ~13% | 13%-14%
Depreciation & Amortization | ~$100M | $95M-$100M

"Our raised outlook reflects the strength of our third quarter performance, continued customer activity across our end markets, and the meaningful progress we are making towards increasing throughput and converting backlog into revenue," said Matt Tobolski. "Expanded capacity, shorter lead times, and continued operational execution provide increased confidence in our ability to deliver strong growth through the remainder of the year.

"We are encouraged by the sequential improvement in gross margin during the third quarter. Higher production volumes, better utilization, pricing actions, sourcing initiatives, and continued operational discipline are beginning to show more clearly in our results. While additional work remains, we expect continued progress in the fourth quarter and remain confident in the long-term earnings power and cash generation potential of the business."
Restatement of Previously Issued Quarterly Financial Statements & Material Weakness

The Company has restated its previously issued financial statements for the first and second quarters of 2026. In aggregate, the restatements resulted in increases to first-half 2026 net sales, gross margin, and GAAP diluted EPS of $10.7 million, 71 basis points, and $0.09, respectively.

Management concluded that restatements to previously issued interim financial statements were appropriate and that a material weakness existed in internal control over financial reporting. The Company has implemented corrective actions and is executing additional measures designed to further strengthen our control environment and internal controls over financial reporting. The Company found no evidence of fraud or misconduct in connection with these matters and believes the identified errors do not alter the underlying strength of the business or its long-term growth outlook.

The impact of the restated first and second quarter of 2026 financial statements to correct for the identified errors can be seen at the end of this release or in Footnote 2 of the restated 10-Q filings for the first and second quarters of 2026, being filed today. Additional information regarding the material weakness can be found in Item 4 of the third quarter 10-Q filing, also being filed today.
